• FlashGuard — Real-Time Fraud Detection on Pathway (IITISoC 2026) Jul 2026
Pathway, XGBoost, Half-Space Trees, LangGraph, RAG, Redis, Docker
  • Built the core streaming pipeline in Pathway: Kafka ingestion, live joins with profiles and sanctions watchlists, and 10-min sliding-window analytics per account.

  • Built a live compliance RAG on Pathway's DocumentStore that hot-reloads AML/KYC policies without a restart.
  • Used Pathway event streams as an audit ledger of agent decisions; ambiguous cases go to LangGraph, with a Redis watchdog cutting token use 80%+.
• Tacotron2 + HiFi-GAN — End-to-End Neural Text-to-Speech 2026
PyTorch, Tacotron2, HiFi-GAN, HF Accelerate, LJSpeech
  • Built a modular TTS stack in PyTorch (text frontend → Tacotron2 → HiFi-GAN) with a decoupled tokenizer, so new scripts (e.g., Indic) need only vocabulary/frontend changes.
  • Implemented Tacotron2 from scratch: Conv1D + BiLSTM encoder, location-sensitive attention for robust text-audio alignment, 2-layer LSTM decoder with PreNet, 5-layer Conv1D PostNet.
  • Streaming-ready inference: step-wise autoregressive mel decoding with stop-token gating into a fully convolutional HiFi-GAN (256× upsampling, MRF, MPD + MSD).
  • Curated LJSpeech mels (dB-scaled, [-4, 4]) and generated a synthetic Tacotron2 mel corpus to fine-tune HiFi-GAN via Accelerate; UTMOS 3.37 → 3.74 (Griffin-Lim: 1.88).
• GPT from Scratch — Decoder-Only Transformer 2026
PyTorch, Transformers, RoPE, Tiny Shakespeare
  • Implemented a ~10M parameter decoder-only Transformer from scratch in PyTorch (6 layers, 6 heads, 384-d): causal multi-head attention, RoPE, GELU, residual connections.
  • Built a modular data, training and generation pipeline with a character-level tokenizer, 90/10 split, validation tracking, periodic + best-model checkpointing, and gradient clipping.
  • Added weight tying, label smoothing, and 200-step warmup + cosine LR decay for training stability.
  • Added autoregressive generation with temperature and top-k sampling; validation loss dropped from 4.19 to ~1.95.
